name: Emirates Apparel
headline: Home of Quality Plain & Personalised Apparel and Wholesale Custom T-Shirts
lede: The one-stop shop for fine-quality wholesale custom T-shirts, jackets, caps, bags and other plain & printed apparel. Ask about free shipping in the UAE.
services: The Home of BLANK & CUSTOMISED Clothing
about: Furthermore, to smoothen the entire process for our T-shirt printing in Dubai, customers can just place bulk orders on our online portal for the blank apparel that they need – polo shirts, T-shirts, sweats, or hoodies. We are stocked with internationally known brands such as Anvil, Gildan, Russell, and Fruit of the Loom, and we offer all our products in male, female and children’s sizes.

We can also connect you to the best companies in T-shirt printing in Dubai, and you can directly communicate to them all the instructions you have for your T-shirt printing needs. You can indicate the design you want, the brand and clothing style you want from Emirates Apparel where the design will be printed, and the number of pieces you will need.
